text:
mira: Anybody else hit weird okhttp behavior where a streaming response mid-download gets canceled when the device switches networks? Seen in our Android sample apps — retrofit streams cut off with `java.io.IOException: connection aborted` then our retry stack retries the whole stream.

dan: which okhttp + retrofit versions? is this reproducing on emulator or physical?

mira: okhttp 4.11 + retrofit 2.9. physical devices (Pixel 6a). repro: start a 60s long streaming /v1/stream, then toggle wifi -> cell, the call cancels immediately. stack: 

```
E/OkHttp: java.io.IOException: Connection aborted
   at okhttp3.internal.connection.ExchangeFinder.findConnection(ExchangeFinder.kt:...)
   at okhttp3.internal.http2.Http2Stream.read(Http2Stream.kt:...)
Caused by: java.net.SocketException: Software caused connection abort
```

samir: sounds similar to the battery-saver Doze issue but triggered by network switch. our retry policy treats connection abort the same as other transient IO and replays. that duplicates partial uploads/streams.

olivia: for streaming endpoints we should avoid blind retry. maybe mark streaming calls as non-retriable by default. expose option for callers to opt-in.

mira: agreed. also noticed that setting `connectionPool` to a tiny size made it worse — connections weren't reused and new handshakes under poor mobile conditions failed. current builder: 

```
OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .connectionPool(ConnectionPool(2, 60, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
  .build()
```

dan: can you try `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` and implement thin client-side retry with backoff and network-change awareness? e.g., listen for CONNECTIVITY_ACTION and delay retry until connected.

samir: also recommend `EventListener` to log cancellation reasons and attach FailureReason metadata in SDK so apps can make better decisions.

olivia: for the sample app let's add a toggle to mark requests as STREAMING vs UNARY and show recommended config. That will make onboarding less confusing.

ci-bot: Created ticket SDK-909: "Android SDK: avoid automatic retries for streaming endpoints; document network-switch behavior" (<https://issues.redwood/SDK-909>)

mira: I'll open a PR to change default retry behavior for streaming endpoints and add a sample toggle in the sampleapp.
dan: include test matrix for wifi->cell and airplane-mode toggles across Android 10-14. Capture logs with `adb bugreport`.
samir: and add singleflight for token refresh to avoid duplicate refreshes when retrying non-idempotent calls.

olivia: tiny UX ask: in the onboarding guide mention `retryOnConnectionFailure` caveats and show how to set up idempotency tokens for streaming uploads.
mira: will do. PR soon. thanks.
